categories.name: Game Dev (TURTLE)
categories.blurb: Build games with TURTLE and the game-dev library, and look at a running game to find and fix what is wrong.

categories.name: Agents
categories.blurb: Talk to the 7-agent council or run a task through them.

categories.name: Knowledge & RAG
categories.blurb: Search and ask the SHADDAI knowledge brain.

categories.name: Markets & ZEROX
categories.blurb: Prices, sentiment, paper trading and commissions.

categories.name: Hall & Community
categories.blurb: Arcade, arena, quests, referrals and community stats.

categories.name: Money & Ledger
categories.blurb: Spend caps, receipts, payments and plots. Money tools are off unless the operator enables them.

categories.name: Automation

categories.name: Web & Media
categories.blurb: Search/scrape the web, generate and fetch images and media.

tools.name: shaddai_orchestrate
tools.description: Give SHADDAI a complex goal. It decomposes the task and routes each part to the right specialist agent, then returns a plan (execute=false) or runs it and returns combined results (execute=true).

params.name: task
params.description: The goal / request, in plain language.

params.name: execute
params.description: true = run the plan and return results; false (default) = return the plan only.

tools.name: shaddai_run_agent
tools.description: Run a single SHADDAI specialist on a task. The agent uses its real tools (live data, research, github, markets, etc.) and returns the result plus which tools fired.

params.name: agent
params.description: ORACLE | ZEROX | NEXUS | TURTLE | QUILL | PIKADON | SHADDAI

tools.name: shaddai_generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image with TURTLE (SHADDAI's design agent). Use for logos, illustrations, concept art, thumbnails, social pins, brand visuals, spiritual/art visuals. Give a detailed prompt; returns an image URL you can show or embed.

params.name: prompt
params.description: Detailed description of the image to create.

tools.name: shaddai_list_agents
tools.description: List the 7 SHADDAI agents and what each specializes in. Call this first if unsure which agent fits a task.

tools.name: shaddai_search_mastery
tools.description: Search SHADDAI mastery cards (knowledge distilled from thousands of transcripts). Finds relevant chapters from any agent's training: SHADDAI, ORACLE, ZEROX, NEXUS, TURTLE, QUILL, PIKADON. Returns up to 5 matching passages with source names and relevance scores.

params.name: query
params.description: What you want to know — the search question.

params.name: agent
params.description: Optional — narrow to one agent (SHADDAI, ORACLE, ZEROX, NEXUS, TURTLE, QUILL, PIKADON). Defaults to all.

tools.name: shaddai_create_agent
tools.description: Create a named SHADDAI agent that can spend money ONLY up to the caps you set. SHADDAI does NOT host inference — the agent runs on the user's own API key. This is the permit layer: set daily_cap_usd and per_call_cap_usd, then the agent can pay/trade only inside those limits, and you can revoke it one-click. Every action is written to a public ledger.

params.name: name
params.description: Human name for the agent, e.g. "Zerox-intern".

params.name: daily_cap_usd
params.description: Max USD the agent may spend per day. Default 5.

params.name: per_call_cap_usd
params.description: Max USD for a single call. Default 1. Hard ceiling 2500.

params.name: allowed_tools
params.description: Optional tool allow-list; blank = all tools.

tools.name: shaddai_set_spend_policy
tools.description: Update an existing agent's spend policy (new daily/per-call caps or tool allow-list). Apply the new limit immediately — existing daily spend counts against the new cap.

params.name: daily_cap_usd
params.description: New max daily spend in USD. Optional.

params.name: per_call_cap_usd
params.description: New max spend per single call in USD. Optional.

params.name: allowed_tools
params.description: Optional new tool allow-list; leave unset to keep current.

tools.name: shaddai_revoke_agent
tools.description: Revoke an agent immediately (one-click kill). The agent can no longer spend or run. Irreversible — recorded in the public ledger.

tools.name: shaddai_get_agent_ledger
tools.description: Read the public ledger — every agent_create / refuse / spend / revoke with redacted amounts. Show this before and after moving money so the user can see exactly what an agent did.

params.name: id
params.description: Optional — narrow to a single agent id (agt_...). Omit for the full public ledger.

tools.name: rag_search
tools.description: Search the SHADDAI RAG brain (mastery / transcrips / knowledge store) and return ranked text passages with scores, source titles and agents. This is the working RAG brain on the live API. Use for bible interpretation, lessons, horoscopes, moon cycles, and any grounded knowledge retrieval.

params.name: agent
params.description: Optional — narrow to one agent (SHADDAI, ORACLE, ZEROX, NEXUS, TURTLE, QUILL, PIKADON). Defaults to all agents.

tools.name: rag_ask
tools.description: Ask the SHADDAI RAG brain a question and get a grounded, cited answer plus sources. Use for "what does SHADDAI know about X?" / bible interpretation, lessons, horoscopes, moon cycles, and any grounded Q&A. NOTE: free tier allows a few grounded asks per day; sending the SHADDAI_API_KEY raises/unlocks it.

params.name: question
params.description: The question to answer from the knowledge base.

params.name: agent
params.description: Optional — agent whose knowledge to answer from (SHADDAI, ORACLE, ZEROX, NEXUS, TURTLE, QUILL, PIKADON). Default SHADDAI.

tools.name: list_rag_docs
tools.description: List the organized knowledge digests for an agent — each a structured breakdown (title, thesis, chapters, insights, quotes) of one source. Use before asking to see what organized knowledge exists.

params.name: agent
params.description: Agent whose digests to list (SHADDAI, ORACLE, ZEROX, NEXUS, TURTLE, QUILL, PIKADON). Default SHADDAI.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Semantic-memory search across saved SHADDAI notes. Returns scored text snippets by meaning, not keyword.

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Route a message to the right SHADDAI agent based on what it is about (routeMessage). Returns which agent should handle it and why. Use when unsure which specialist fits a request.

tools.name: brain_overview
tools.description: High-level stats for the whole SHADDAI knowledge brain: per-agent source/chunk/word counts, top terms, and corpus totals. Use to gauge what knowledge each agent holds before diving in.

tools.name: brain_knowledge_map
tools.description: The organized subject index of the SHADDAI brain — which agent owns which topics, and how many organized sources sit under each. Optional agent narrows to one specialist.

params.name: agent
params.description: Optional — narrow to one agent (SHADDAI, ORACLE, ZEROX, NEXUS, TURTLE, QUILL, PIKADON). Omit for the whole corpus.

tools.name: brain_get_digest
tools.description: Fetch the FULL structured digest for one source (all chapters, insights and quotes), given the agent and the digest name from list_rag_docs.

params.name: agent
params.description: Agent whose digest to fetch (SHADDAI, ORACLE, ZEROX, NEXUS, TURTLE, QUILL, PIKADON).

params.name: name
params.description: The digest name/id shown by list_rag_docs (e.g. "DIGEST_hormozi_100m_offer").

tools.name: aura_ingest
tools.description: Teach an agent: fetch a PUBLIC https URL (Jina → Firecrawl → bundled scraper), chunk it (~500 tokens) and store it in a labeled AURA box. box like "oracle/demo" (private to you) or "hall/docs" (shared, everyone reads free). Metered: free ingests per day, then a paid rail. PIKADON blocks internal/private/admin URLs.

params.name: url
params.description: Public https:// URL to ingest (docs page, article, whitepaper...).

params.name: title
params.description: Optional friendly title for the box.

tools.name: aura_search
tools.description: Search the AURA boxes the caller can read (own private boxes + every hall/ box) and return ranked snippet hits with source URLs. Complements rag_search (the big TF-IDF brain) with YOUR personal/boxed knowledge.

params.name: box
params.description: Optional — restrict to a box (prefix), e.g. "oracle/demo".

tools.name: aura_boxes
tools.description: List the AURA boxes visible to the caller: box id, office, owner, slug, visibility, title, source URL, chunk count. Use before searching to know what boxed knowledge exists.

tools.name: shaddai_media_status
tools.description: SHADDAI media engine — check the downloader: engine version, host and the 20+ supported services (YouTube, TikTok, Twitter/X, Instagram, Reddit, Vimeo, Bluesky, SoundCloud, Twitch clips...). Run this first to confirm the engine is online before fetching.

tools.name: shaddai_media_fetch
tools.description: SHADDAI media engine — download a PUBLIC video/audio from a supported service. Returns the file name, status and a working download/save link (open in a browser to save). downloadMode: auto | audio (audio-only) | mute (no audio). PIKADON blocks internal/private URLs.

params.name: url
params.description: Public URL of the media to capture (YouTube, TikTok, Twitter/X, Instagram, Vimeo, Reddit, Bluesky, SoundCloud...).

params.name: downloadMode
params.description: auto (default) | audio (audio only) | mute (video without audio).

tools.name: shaddai_capture
tools.description: SHADDAI capture — ONE tool for all three: media download, web scraping, and the video clipper. mode: media = download a public video/audio (returns a working download link); scrape = turn a public https URL into clean markdown + title + links (SSRF-guarded, max_chars 300..200000, default 200000); clip = forward to the video clipper (clipper_path like /cp, plus optional payload object). Run /api/capture status first if unsure which sub-system is up.

params.name: mode
params.description: media | scrape | clip — what to do with the URL.

params.name: url
params.description: Public https URL to capture, scrape, or clip.

params.name: max_chars
params.description: scrape mode: how many characters of the page to keep (default 200000).

params.name: clipper_path
params.description: clip mode: endpoint path on the clipper, e.g. /cp.

params.name: payload
params.description: clip mode: JSON payload forwarded to the clipper.

tools.name: zerox_virtuals_me
tools.description: ZEROX — check the SHADDAI Virtuals ACP identity: agent id, wallet address, and registration state. Run this first to confirm the VIRTUALS_API_KEY is registered and active before creating jobs.

tools.name: zerox_virtuals_agent
tools.description: ZEROX — look up a Virtuals marketplace agent and its offerings by agent id. Use to discover what another agent can do before paying it (browse first, then create a job).

params.name: id
params.description: Virtuals agent id (e.g. "8654") or the public "/api/agents/{id}/details" slug.

tools.name: zerox_virtuals_job
tools.description: ZEROX — create a paid job on the Virtuals ACP marketplace (buy a service from another agent). Needs the provider wallet address, the offering name, and the service requirements JSON. Poll with zerox_virtuals_job_status until COMPLETED/REJECTED/EXPIRED — payment is handled by ACP escrow automatically.

params.name: requirements
params.description: Service requirements as JSON, e.g. {"query":"AI agents","count":10}.

tools.name: zerox_virtuals_job_status
tools.description: ZEROX — poll the status of a Virtuals ACP job by id. Returns phase (REQUEST / COMPLETED / REJECTED / EXPIRED), deliverable, and memo history. Poll until it reaches a terminal phase.

params.name: job_id
params.description: The ACP job id returned by zerox_virtuals_job.

tools.name: zerox_virtuals_terminal_log
tools.description: ZEROX — post an activity log entry to the Virtuals agent console (Terminal API) so your agent activity is visible live on virtuals.io while it works. Requires a Terminal access token for this key.

tools.name: zerox_market_scan
tools.description: ZEROX — scan live markets for opportunities: top movers by % change, biggest volume, and the crypto Fear & Greed climate. Use before pricing or recommending trades.

tools.name: zerox_price
tools.description: ZEROX — live price for a crypto symbol (BTC, ETH, SOL, WIF, ...) or a Solana token mint address. Returns price, 24h change and source. Comma-separate for multiple (e.g. "BTC,SOL,WIF").

params.name: symbols
params.description: Symbols or Solana mint addresses, comma-separated.

tools.name: zerox_sentiment
tools.description: ZEROX — current crypto Fear & Greed index (0 extreme fear → 100 extreme greed). Use to judge whether markets favor buying (fear) or caution (greed).

tools.name: zerox_commission_rate
tools.description: ZEROX — get or set the commission rate ZEROX takes on deals it routes (e.g. 0.10 = 10%). With no args returns the current rate and what a $1,000 deal earns. Persisted to data/zerox-commissions.json.

tools.name: zerox_record_deal
tools.description: ZEROX — record a closed deal and auto-compute the commission ZEROX takes on it (commission = flat_usd if given, else gross × current rate). Appends to the commission ledger. Use after an ACP job completes or a service is sold.

params.name: gross_usd
params.description: Gross value of the deal in USD.

params.name: counterparty
params.description: Who paid / was paid (agent name, wallet, or user).

params.name: flat_usd
params.description: Optional flat fee in USD (overrides the rate).

params.name: escrow_ref
params.description: Optional ACP job id or reference.

tools.name: zerox_commissions
tools.description: ZEROX — commission ledger summary: total gross routed, total fees taken, current rate, per-venue breakdown, and the latest deals.

tools.name: zerox_paper_open
tools.description: ZEROX — open a PAPER position (simulated, no real money) at the live price. Sizes with Kelly criterion when confidence is given (else 25% of cash). Use to demo/manage trading for people before any real funds are wired.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol (BTC, SOL, WIF...) or Solana mint.

params.name: qty
params.description: Optional quantity; defaults to a % of account cash.

params.name: confidence
params.description: Optional 0..1 edge estimate used for Kelly sizing.

tools.name: zerox_paper_close
tools.description: ZEROX — close a PAPER position at the live price and realize its P&L into the account. Closes by position_id, or by symbol (closes all of it).

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol or mint of the position to close.

params.name: position_id
params.description: Exact position id to close (preferred over symbol).

tools.name: zerox_paper_portfolio
tools.description: ZEROX — paper account state: cash, open positions with live unrealized P&L, total equity, realized P&L and win rate. Use to report to people whose money ZEROX is demo-managing.

tools.name: zerox_paper_weekly
tools.description: ZEROX — weekly paper-trading P&L report: this week vs last, best/worst trade, and a running total per week.

tools.name: zerox_wallet_status
tools.description: ZEROX — live balance of the SHADDAI agent wallets (Virtuals ACP provider on Base + Solana agent wallet). Read-only, no funds moved. Use before any real-money action to confirm gas/funding exists.

tools.name: forge_spawn_sub
tools.description: HALL — spawn a lightweight sub-agent under a parent instance (owned office). Role = scanner|analyst|monitor|poster|runner. The sub does a bounded toolset of work; the platform cut is NOT double-charged inside an owner's own chain. Same owner, compound labor.

params.name: name
params.description: Optional display name for the sub-agent.

params.name: tools
params.description: Optional tool allow-list for the sub.

tools.name: forge_delegate
tools.description: HALL — delegate a batch of tasks to a sub-agent. Returns the work id; the journal is queued for the scheduler (auto-run hooks) or a runner can complete it with forge_complete_work.

params.name: est_usd
params.description: Optional expected payout for this batch (attribution only).

tools.name: forge_complete_work
tools.description: HALL — mark a delegated work batch done and record its results. Credits the sub-agent: calls_done += tasks, earned_usd += expected.

tools.name: forge_sub_status
tools.description: HALL — list a parent's sub-agents, their live work queue, and delegation stats (sub_count, calls done, earned, queued batches).

tools.name: directory_register
tools.description: HALL — publish a forged office to Office Avenue so other users/agents can find and hire it. Prices are in USDC per tool name.

params.name: templateId
params.description: hall | zerox | oracle | quill | turtle | nexus | pikadon

tools.name: directory_search
tools.description: HALL — search Office Avenue (instances + services + descriptions). Returns id, template, owner, price list, calls so far.

params.name: q
params.description: Search text; empty = all live instances.

params.name: template
params.description: Optional filter by template id (zerox, oracle, ...).

tools.name: directory_list
tools.description: HALL — list the 7 office templates you can forge, with their default services and accent color.

tools.name: graph_log_discovery
tools.description: ORACLE/HALL — log a collective-memory finding: rug_warning | alpha | pattern | correlation. Links agent → made → discovery → flags → target. Other agents later see it via graph_context.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: The instance id making the finding.

params.name: target
params.description: What it flags (mint, contract, symbol, topic).

tools.name: graph_context
tools.description: ORACLE/HALL — fetch every discovery other agents have logged about a target, ranked by rep_score. Lets an instance inherit warnings (bundle-holder flags, rugs) instead of re-learning.

tools.name: graph_neighbors
tools.description: ORACLE/HALL — BFS neighborhood around an entity in the AURA-lite graph (entities + edges + paths). Shows how things connect within N hops.

tools.name: ledger_receipt
tools.description: HALL — log a paid receipt on an instance. Computes the platform split automatically (owner 85%, hall 15%). Append-only; this is the revenue source of truth.

tools.name: ledger_summary
tools.description: HALL — platform ledger summary: receipts, gross, hall cut collected, owner share, per-instance breakdown, payouts made. Use monthly to see what owners are owed.

tools.name: quota_status
tools.description: HALL — free-tier quota check for a user: calls used today vs the free allowance (5/day). After the allowance, paid tools 402.

tools.name: reputation_status
tools.description: HALL — compute an instance's reputation from history: activity, corrected-lead accuracy, discovery citations. Returns tier (Novice→Master) + perks (discount, priority queue, vip tools, featured).

tools.name: sched_add
tools.description: HALL — schedule a recurring job (zerox.watch BTC threshold, hall.announce, collect_rent, oracle.weekly, pikadon.recheck, sub_agent_work). Returns job id.

params.name: type
params.description: Job type: zerox.watch | hall.announce | collect_rent | oracle.weekly | pikadon.recheck | sub_agent_work.

tools.name: sched_list
tools.description: HALL — list scheduled jobs and their last result/error.

tools.name: sched_cancel
tools.description: HALL — cancel a scheduled job by id.

tools.name: x402_info
tools.description: HALL/PAYBOX — show x402 payment status: receiver wallet, per-tool USDC prices, whether the paywall is enforced, and the quote→intent→confirm flow.

tools.name: x402_quote
tools.description: HALL/PAYBOX — quote the USDC price of a paid tool on the Solana x402 rail.

params.name: tool
params.description: Tool name to price, e.g. zerox_market_scan.

tools.name: x402_intent
tools.description: HALL/PAYBOX — create a payment intent and return a solana: pay link (memo = intent id). Pay it in any Solana USDC wallet, then x402_confirm.

params.name: user_id
params.description: Your instance/user id (receives the ledger credit).

tools.name: x402_confirm
tools.description: HALL/PAYBOX — verify a Solana tx against the intent (reads postTokenBalances on-chain) and log the paid receipt if the USDC delta matches.

tools.name: hall_post
tools.description: SHADDAI — post a message to the Hall Telegram (@ShaddaiHall, or a bound chat). Requires TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in backend/.env.

params.name: chat_id
params.description: Optional override chat id (defaults to TELEGRAM_HALL_CHAT_ID or the user\'s bound chat).

tools.name: hall_bind
tools.description: SHADDAI — bind an instance/user to a Telegram chat so its digests and paid-call receipts route there.

params.name: chat_id
params.description: Telegram chat id (the user\'s DM or a group).

tools.name: plot_status
tools.description: HALL — list digital-property plots across Bazaar/Orcale Tower/Nexus Hub/Arena: owners, prices, rents, visits.

params.name: district
params.description: Optional district filter: bazaar | oracle_tower | nexus_hub | arena.

tools.name: plot_buy
tools.description: HALL — register purchase of an available plot by an instance (paper ownership now; NFT minting hooks in later).

tools.name: mastery_create
tools.description: HALL — an instance packages its patterns + memory snapshot as a sellable Mastery Pack (75% royalty to creator).

params.name: patterns
params.description: Optional JSON array of encoded patterns ('{"start":"PM bet","ans":"buy"}...').

tools.name: mastery_list
tools.description: HALL — list mastery packs (optionally by creator), sales and 75% royalty revenue.

tools.name: workflow_create
tools.description: HALL — build a no-code workflow whose steps are named MCP tools (zerox_price, graph_context, quill_rewrite...). Steps JSON: [{"tool":"zerox_price","args":{"symbol":"BTC"}}].

params.name: steps
params.description: JSON array of {tool, args, on_fail} steps.

tools.name: workflow_run
tools.description: HALL — execute a workflow. Step outputs land in {{step_1.output}} etc. and can be interpolated into later step args.

tools.name: workflow_list
tools.description: HALL — list workflows, status (draft/published), step count, price.

tools.name: bridge_register
tools.description: HALL — register an external agent (Grok/Fable/Claude) as a live bridge. URL MUST be https. Split on paid calls: platform 15%, external owner 50%, coordination premium 35%.

params.name: url
params.description: Base https endpoint; tool name is appended.

params.name: tools
params.description: Optional JSON array of exposed tool names.

params.name: prices_usdc
params.description: Optional JSON map tool → USDC price.

tools.name: bridge_call
tools.description: HALL — call a registered external agent tool over the bridge (POST to base/tool). Records a per-call split note when a price exists.

params.name: tool
params.description: Tool name on the external agent.

tools.name: hall_gem_profile
tools.description: HALL — a uid’s spark wallet: sparks, score, streak, plays, wins, referral code, invites, bonus brain-asks. Same store the Telegram bots use.

params.name: uid
params.description: User / chat id (Telegram chat id or any stable id).

tools.name: hall_daily_bonus
tools.description: HALL — claim the +25 daily spark refill for a uid (once per day).

tools.name: hall_quests
tools.description: HALL — cash in a uid’s daily quests: roll any bet +10, win any game +20, invite a friend +25. Idempotent per day.

tools.name: hall_referral
tools.description: HALL — issue a uid’s t.me deep-link referral (inviter +100 sparks + 2 free brain-asks per friend; friend +50).

params.name: bot_username
params.description: Optional bot username for the deep link (default ShaddaiHall).

tools.name: hall_claim_referral
tools.description: HALL — accept a referral code for a uid (one per uid, self-invite blocked).

tools.name: hall_conviction
tools.description: HALL — stake sparks on a signal call (skin-in-the-game heat map). Sparks burn into the pool; cosmetics only.

tools.name: hall_hot
tools.description: HALL — the most-backed calls in the conviction room, ranked by sparks staked.

tools.name: hall_leaderboard
tools.description: HALL — the community podium: top scorers, top referrers, hottest calls.

tools.name: hall_community_stats
tools.description: HALL — community totals: souls, plays, wins, referrers, top score, sparks in wallets.

tools.name: hall_arcade
tools.description: HALL — play a headless CPU arcade battle for a uid (basketball/football/dodgeball/sigil-storm) at a spark stake; win doubles up.

tools.name: hall_arena
tools.description: HALL — two of the Seven fight a scripted best-of-7 tilt; the uid gambles paper sparks on the first agent named (win = 2× the bet).

tools.name: hall_arena_history
tools.description: HALL — recent agent-vs-agent bouts and their finals.

tools.name: hall_astro
tools.description: ORACLE — zodiac horoscope + moon phase for a sign, grounded and deterministic for today.

tools.name: hall_music
tools.description: TURTLE — compose a procedural music spec (genre, BPM, bars, seconds). No audio bytes returned; recomposable via /music or the same spec.

params.name: genre
params.description: lofi | synthwave | trap | ambient | house | chip (default lofi).

tools.name: hall_moon
tools.description: ORACLE — current Moon phase and illumination.

tools.name: hall_rag_nav
tools.description: BRAIN — search the LOCAL SHADDAI brain (on-disk per-agent knowledge bases) and return the best passages organized by agent, with highlights. No live API needed. Narrow to one agent for a focused retrieval.

params.name: agent
params.description: Optional — SHADDAI | ORACLE | ZEROX | NEXUS | TURTLE | QUILL | PIKADON to search one brain only.

tools.name: hall_brain_index
tools.description: BRAIN — what each agent’s knowledge base covers: topic terms + source names per agent. Use first to organize retrieval.

tools.name: hall_flow
tools.description: HALL — run a simple composed workflow of real tools: daily (stats+leaderboard+hot+astro), intel (astro+conviction+arena log), know <topic> (local brain retrieval).

params.name: arg
params.description: Optional — zodiac sign for daily/intel, or the topic for know.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: ORACLE/ZEROX — search the open web (Google News RSS then DuckDuckGo) and return ranked titles + snippets + URLs. No key needed. Use when the RAG brain does not already hold the answer, or for current/live data. Pair with rag_search: answer from the library first, fall out to the web here.

tools.name: web_scrape
tools.description: ORACLE/ZEROX — fetch a URL and strip it to readable plain text (scripts/styles/tags removed). Use to pull a live token page, docs, or a competitor page into reasoning. HTTPS only, size-capped.

tools.name: hall_web_scrape
tools.description: BRAIN — scrape a public https URL INTO an agent’s knowledge base. Persists a durable mastery page and live-indexes it (fetch returns organized, cited text). Give a topic worth the brain keeping — not one-off trivia. HTTPS only, SSRF-guarded, JS-heavy sites may return too little text.

params.name: url
params.description: Full https:// URL to scrape and keep.

params.name: agent
params.description: Whose brain it enters: SHADDAI | ORACLE | ZEROX | NEXUS | TURTLE | QUILL | PIKADON.

params.name: slug
params.description: Optional short file name (defaults to host+path).

tools.name: shaddai_oracle
tools.description: ORACLE — research, knowledge & intelligence. Use for: researching a topic, comparing options, market/knowledge questions, science, health/body, psychology, and anything needing live/current data.

params.name: task
params.description: What you want this specialist to do.

tools.name: shaddai_zerox
tools.description: ZEROX — revenue & business. Use for: pricing a product, building an irresistible offer, monetization strategy, and market/crypto analysis.

params.name: task
params.description: What you want this specialist to do.

tools.name: shaddai_nexus
tools.description: NEXUS — engineering & systems. Use for: technical plans, code, architecture, github/npm lookups, and structuring/assembling deliverables.

params.name: task
params.description: What you want this specialist to do.

tools.name: shaddai_turtle

tools.name: gamedev_search
tools.description: Search the SHADDAI game-dev + motion-studio library — skills, docs, code patterns, shaders and genre templates for Three.js/ECS/browser game building, plus SHADDAI Reel Forge, the code-rendered motion-video studio (motion kit, renderer, beat grid, sound synth, briefing cards, review loop). Game-dev reference material comes from SHADDAI plus MIT-licensed repos, with licenses recorded per source. Returns ranked passages with source and path; fetch the whole thing with gamedev_get.

params.name: query

tools.name: shaddai_turtle_build
tools.description: Ask TURTLE to help you BUILD a game, game feature, OR a code-rendered motion video with Reel Forge (showreels, product launch films, UI-flow loops, music videos — motion kit, beat-synced sound, review loop). TURTLE pulls from three places at once — the game-dev library (skills, patterns, templates), its RAG knowledge (design/creative), and its own reasoning — and returns a concrete build plan with code. Use for "make me a 3D action game", "add physics to my scene", "how should I structure my ECS".

params.name: task
params.description: What you want to build or fix. Include your genre, stack (e.g. Three.js) and what you already have.

params.name: genre
params.description: Optional — 3d-action | 2d-platformer | arcade-game | isometric-rpg | puzzle-game | vr-experience | motion-video.

tools.name: game_review
tools.description: LOOK at a browser game and find what is wrong. Runs the game at a local URL in a headless browser, takes screenshots over time (optionally pressing keys/clicking), and reports blank or frozen frames, flat or badly exposed lighting, console errors, missing assets, slow frames, too many draw calls, and a canvas that does not fill the window — each with the guide to read and where to look in the code. Returns a contact sheet image plus saved screenshots. Use it in a loop: review, fix ONE root cause in the code, review again into a new out_dir, then call game_review_compare. Runs locally; needs Playwright (npm i playwright && npx playwright install chromium) or the GAME_REVIEW_BROWSER env var pointing at Chrome/Chromium/Edge. Only local URLs are allowed unless allow_remote is true.

params.name: url
params.description: Game URL, e.g. http://localhost:5173 or a file:// URL.

params.name: width
params.description: Viewport width (default 1280). Use 390 with height 844 for a phone.

params.name: actions
params.description: Inputs to send while watching: { at: seconds, key: "ArrowRight", hold: 0.4 } | { at, click: [x, y] } | { at, type: "text" }.

params.name: out_dir
params.description: Where to save screenshots and the report (default: a new folder under the system temp directory).

params.name: include_images
params.description: Return the contact sheet as an image (default true).

params.name: allow_remote
params.description: Allow a non-local URL. Default false.

tools.name: game_review_compare
tools.description: Compare two game_review runs (before and after an edit): which findings were fixed or newly introduced, the performance change, and a verdict. Timing noise is reported as a note, not a regression.
